mapper.select: SELECT u.id , u.user_id , u.password , u.created_at , u.created_by , u.updated_at , u.updated_by , u.user_nm , u.email , u.status , u.last_login_at , u.role_id , r.role_code FROM basic_user u JOIN basic_role r ON u.role_id = r.id WHERE u.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO basic_user ( user_id, password, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by, user_nm, email, role_id ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{password}, NOW(), #{createdBy}, NOW(), #{updatedBy}, #{userNm}, #{email}, #{roleId} )
